name: held-text-record-is-dormant
description: A workflow value, src/versions.ts, names a file of the program as a path, so the held text holds that file and its exports, while the word versions in a comment names none. The directive on its test-only export is then neither in effect nor stale: a hold is a question the analysis leaves open, not evidence that the code changed, so the record is dormant, nothing is reported about the export and the run fails on no stale suppression.
